authority: non-authoritative executable-oracle input; the integration train owns public activation after granting every required lock

receiver_contract.identity_owner: method or interface declaration and function type
receiver_contract.body_role: validate implementation effects do not exceed the declaration
fixed_forms: static and receiver mode are mutually exclusive
constructor owns construction-only mutable this and declares no receiver mode
sync-interior mutation is a sealed typed-registry capability and adds no public mode
receiver_contract.override_rule: receiver mode must exactly match the base or interface declaration

borrow_origin_contract.normalized_type_field: XrFunctionType.view_origin_set[] stores canonical (kind, parameter ordinal) rows
borrow_origin_contract.elision_type_field: XrFunctionType.view_origin_was_elided is diagnostic/source-map data and not type identity
borrow_origin_contract.canonical_identity: sorted and deduplicated (kind, parameter ordinal) set
eligibility: READ parameter whose input type is a total type-system match for the returned const Slice backing storage
READ receiver whose input type is a total type-system match for the returned const Slice backing storage

elision.explicit_set: bind and validate the declared set without running elision
elision.zero_signature_candidates: reject with OWN-E-VIEW-ORIGIN-INVALID unless static is explicit

required_invariants: borrowed return origin set is nonempty
parameter and receiver origins retain READ mode
each return-path provenance is a member of the normalized set
static provenance creates no invalidatable caller root
return_surface_constraints: the first public cut permits only direct const Slice<T> borrowed returns
tuple union enum and struct may not conceal a borrowed return
local temporary and unknown provenance cannot impersonate static or input provenance
static origin storage is readonly and lives for the program or module use period
interface extern bodyless declaration function value import sidecar and dynamic target normalize from the signature
every dynamic target has an exactly equal normalized origin set
missing sidecar or inconsistent target set fails closed

domain_transfer_contract.copy_semantics: copy creates a new candidate domain
domain_transfer_contract.move_semantics: move transfers the root token of the same candidate domain

internal_owned_criteria: source and target already share one ownership domain or source enters by legal move adoption
the domain ledger owns the edge lifetime
the edge publishes no ordinary strong handle outside the domain
drop/finalizer order is complete or domain teardown handles the internal strong cycle
the edge carries no execution-affine unknown-foreign or non-transferable weak-table state
adoption_rules: child source domain is CANDIDATE with no loan and a complete plan
child allocation/drop ledger merges or attaches to the parent ownership domain
the parent domain transfer state does not worsen
adoption cannot cross const sync or foreign boundaries or change execution-affine finalizer constraints
external_alias_triggers: ordinary root handle binding or assignment
store into another ownership domain field container or closure
dynamic or foreign call that may retain
publish to module mutable global or unknown storage
stored closure captures a mutable root by reference
ownership_edge_contract.unknown_policy: UNKNOWN edge or provenance fails closed

transfer_rules: create or rebind from an owner or proven view creates a LIVE version with a canonical origin set
read or project a LIVE view preserves its state and origin set
use of INVALIDATED, MAYBE_INVALIDATED, or UNKNOWN rejects
owner-preserving action leaves view state unchanged
owner-invalidating action atomically invalidates every tracked local view with an intersecting origin set
overwriting or leaving scope makes only that view version unreachable
an active, escaped, captured, or foreign-unknown view blocks owner invalidation
view_validity_contract.unknown_precedence: UNKNOWN is the top state and absorbs every other join input
evaluation_order_rules: data.push(len(view)) completes the READ call before receiver invalidation and is allowed
mutate(ref data, view) holds overlapping REF and view facts in one call and is rejected
owner move rebind or destroy invalidates tracked views before owner state commits
any failed check commits neither owner state nor view state
READ REF and immediate non-retaining closure loans end at the enclosing call return
view_validity_contract.source_legality_owner: forward validity state machine and typed invalidation effect

independent_checker_obligations: borrowed return origin set is nonempty sorted deduplicated and ordinal-bounded
parameter and receiver origins are READ and type eligible
every return provenance is a member of the normalized origin set
each invalidation and its owner mutation or move share one plan node
every intersecting local view has a validity transition
active escaped and unknown views are never silently marked dead
every view join is a row in the frozen validity join table
semantic_plan_contract.atomicity_invariant: owner invalidation and every intersecting local-view transition are one semantic action
semantic_plan_contract.fingerprint_role: byte integrity only; structural and semantic verification remains mandatory

forbidden_inference: ownership from VM, C, or helper names
